# 1stStep.ai Partner Program

Canonical URL: https://partners.1ststep.ai/
Product: 1stStep.ai Job Agent
Product URL: https://app.1ststep.ai/

The partner program lets people create a referral link during the free controlled beta. Beta signups may be attributed, but they do not accrue commission and no payouts are active today.

Planned paid-launch terms shown on the site include a 30% recurring commission on eligible paid subscription payments, a 60-day attribution window, monthly payout review after a 30-day payment-confirmation period, and a $50 minimum payout threshold. These terms are planned and may change before paid access opens.

The Job Agent helps people find suitable roles and prepare tailored application documents. Applicants review and submit their own applications.

Support: support@1ststep.ai
Sales and partner questions: sales@1ststep.ai
